summary.text: Soul expending myriad guts formation is Fang Yuan's soul path formation, made from Spectral Soul's true inheritance and his own Immortal Gu, that produces at least ten thousand guts Gu each time.

claims.text: Fang Yuan sets up an immortal formation around Dang Hun Mountain in Mini Southern Border, and Shi Shi Cheng is given permission to manipulate it. When the formation resonates, a grey-blue light shoots out like fog or smoke and surrounds the whole mountain, the mountain’s pink light dyes the fog pink, and the soul beasts and soul cores inside the formation vanish rapidly without a trace. Guts Gu then form, rising from single digits to the thousands and on toward tens of thousands. This soul path formation was made by modifying the contents of Spectral Soul’s true inheritance together with Fang Yuan’s own Immortal Gu, and he named it soul expending myriad guts formation. It produces at least ten thousand guts Gu each time, which is more efficient than Dang Hun Mountain alone, on the condition that enough soul beasts and soul cores are supplied. Fang Yuan has prepared for that supply by arranging a cooperation with Fang clan to develop green ghost desert. His soul goes into the formation directly, and with its help he absorbs and uses ten thousand guts Gu in an instant, so that his soul inflates like a balloon into a giant within a few breaths. He moves between the formation and Luo Po Valley, using guts Gu to recover each time the valley wounds his soul, and after three rounds his soul reaches ten million man soul.
Fang Yuan temporarily puts the dragonman clone in the formation to cultivate, because the clone’s soul foundation needed improving anyway.
